Israel and Lebanon discuss plan to transfer some southern territory to Lebanese army
items.description: Israeli and Lebanese negotiators in Washington are discussing a US-backed pilot project under which Israeli troops would hand back control over some territory in southern Lebanon to the Lebanese Armed Forces, according to officials from the two countries.

items.title: Diabetes patients in Gaza face survival battle amid war shortages
items.description: Insulin and equipment shortages in Gaza pose fatal risks, leading to critical health complications.

items.title: In High-Stakes Bluff, Putin Holds a Losing Hand
items.description: Ukraine’s recent battlefield successes do not bode well for the Kremlin leader. Thanks to Europe’s steady financial and military support for Kyiv, Russia is experiencing casualties unprecedented since World War II. Meanwhile, the US waivers in its historic transatlantic commitment.

items.title: 'It's pure terror against civilians': In Ukraine, Kherson's residents live under constant threat of Russian drones
items.description: In this southern Ukrainian city, separated from enemy positions only by the Dnipro River, Ukrainians claim to have regained the upper hand against a weakened Russian artillery but lack the means to launch a counteroffensive.

items.title: Lebanon's lose-lose: Is there another way out of conflict?
items.description: The new US-Iran peace deal seems to be forcing Lebanon to choose between Israel's sphere of influence or Iran's. It wants neither. But could there be a better alternative, achieved with the help of regional diplomacy?

items.title: Israeli troops kill two in south Lebanon after lull in fighting, authorities say
items.description: Israel's military says the two men were Hezbollah operatives, but the Iran-backed group accuses it of a ceasefire violation.

items.title: Crimea Is Being Strangled. Russian Authorities Are Struggling. Here’s Why (And How) Ukraine Is Doing It
items.description: Since the onset of the all-out invasion in 2022, Ukraine has repeatedly poked at Russian forces -- and Russian tourists -- in occupied Crimea. In recent months, Kyiv’s efforts have become much more deliberate. They appear to be working.

items.title: Israel continues to commit genocide, atrocity crimes by deliberately targeting Palestinian children, UN independent commission finds
items.description: Israeli authorities and security forces have deliberately targeted Palestinian children, resulting in genocide and atrocity crimes in the Gaza Strip and war crimes in the West Bank, a UN independent commission of inquiry said in its latest report released on Tuesday.

items.title: U.S. lifts Iran oil sanctions. And, federal judge rules SAVE voter tool unlawful
items.description: The U.S. has temporarily lifted oil sanctions on Iran as peace talks continue. And, a federal judge ruled that the Trump administration's data system, known as SAVE, is unlawful.

items.title: Vance meets top Iranian officials as US looks to get negotiations back on track
